$comment: What: JSON Schema of config/settings/defaults.json (plan §3.2): one entry per setting, keyed by its UPPER_SNAKE_CASE name (identical to the environment variable that overrides it). How: documentation and editor help; tools/core/settings.mjs checks the same rules when it loads the file (and its unit tests check every entry). Needs: nothing. Outputs: nothing.
title: CCE performance tests settings definitions

default.description: Default value as written by a person: durations as text ("10m"), lists comma-separated, "" = unset (null), "auto" only when allowAuto is true.

appliesTo.description: Tokens: all, subjects (collector, matcher, step-sla), test types (smoke, load, stress, breakpoint) and tools (run, preflight, cleanup, plan-definitions, baseline, report). A setting is relevant to a run when its subject tokens (if any) include the subject and its test-type tokens (if any) include the test type.

toBeConfirmed.description: true = value still to be confirmed from UAT/Dev data or by the team (TBC).

allowAuto.description: true = the value 'auto' is accepted and resolved by tools/core/settings.mjs.
